name: lamtuanvu-marketplace
description: Agent skills marketplace — portable skills for AI coding agents, plus Claude Code plugins

plugins.name: speckit-orchestrator
plugins.description: SpecKit pipeline orchestrator — brainstorm, execute specify→clarify→plan→tasks→analyze→implement, auto-continue via stop hook

plugins.name: loop-templates
plugins.description: Adversarial, self-verifying agentic loop engines (dynamic Workflows) + routing skill. Bundles research/PRD/architecture/build/fix/review engines and the dev-cycle verification engines: speckit-implement (parallel gated implement), plan-review, analyze-consistency.

plugins.name: git-ops
plugins.description: Swappable SCM + issue-tracker adapter for the dev-cycle. One entrypoint — `git-ops on <event> --json` — projects 9 pipeline lifecycle events onto a project tracker + branch/commit/PR conventions. Ships a config-driven GitHub provider (Issues + ProjectV2 + gh SCM).

plugins.name: dev-cycle
plugins.description: The union: run a feature end-to-end through SpecKit + loop-templates + a swappable git-ops tracker + a browser-driven E2E validation harness. General/distributable; hooks project-specifics via provider contracts and .dev-cycle/config.json. Hosts the E2E harness engine (agentic browser driver + ai-judge). Co-install speckit-orchestrator + loop-templates.

plugins.name: ai-video-editor
plugins.description: Process videos into structured JSON metadata with scene detection, audio transcription, and vision analysis for AI-powered video editing workflows

plugins.name: github-ci
plugins.description: GitHub CI failure channel — webhook listener with HMAC, filtering, dedup. Pushes CI failures to Claude Code for auto-fix.

plugins.name: capcut-api
plugins.description: CapCut/JianYing video editing API - create video drafts with video, audio, images, text, subtitles, effects, stickers, and keyframe animations via MCP tools

categories.name: media
categories.description: Media processing and content creation tools
